title: Swiipt Asset Record
description: Canonical asset contract. Derived from Standard v1 section 9 (Asset Engine Contract - format follows customer job, never 'let's make a PDF'), section 10.2 (experience modes), and section 7.3 (asset_map job keys). The asset_map in the product record uses the 8 jobs of section 7.3; this record carries the full 10-job vocabulary from the section 9 table, including CALCULATE and REMEMBER.

asset_id.description: Stable id referenced by transformation_path.required_assets and product.asset_map.

job.description: Section 9 customer job. The Asset Engine asks 'what must the customer do?' - never 'let's make a PDF.'

format.description: Formats enumerated from the section 9 job-to-format table. Adding a new format is a deliberate schema change, not a silent extension.

source_path.description: Path to the authored source content inside the product record store; the delivery engine converts source into supported customer formats.

experience_mode.description: Section 10.2 mode for this asset; must be consistent with the parent product's design.experience_type intent (validator checks).

required.description: Critical assets must not be orphaned or missing at build time (section 14 Assets tests).

safety_relevant.description: True for rescue cards, escalation lists, red-flag self-checks; these get extra scrutiny at Gate 5 and are never decorative.

first_win_role.description: True when this asset delivers the product's first win within the 15-minute limit.

tool_widgets.description: Optional interactive widget tokens ([[TOOL:*]]) embedded in source content; rendered by the live delivery engine.
